support.scope: One pinned Heart full-size FP32 English (US) mel-100 voice with the official snt_nano browser runtime
support.notes: The official Heart model uses its full-size FP32 `snt_nano` module, distinct from heart-nano INT8 and piperlite voices. The same official English G2P/Trellis frontend splits each canonical span into sentence/clause pieces up to 120 characters; non-whitespace dropped symbols, token/output caps or empty synthesis fail closed. CPU/WASM only.

cells.precision: Official heart FP32 front and decoder weights with the matching FP32 snt_nano WebAssembly build

settings.splitPolicy: Official web/index.html splitChunks; sentence and clause pieces up to 120 characters; 93 canonical source IDs preserved.
settings.firstPcm: First completed, nonempty sentence/clause piece is transferred to the page immediately; the official WASM API returns a whole piece before any audio is available.
settings.frontend: Pinned SaanoTrellisFrontend + espeak-ng WASM en-us; max 207 phoneme tokens including BOS/EOS; non-whitespace dropped symbols fail closed.
settings.deterministicSeed: Official snt_nano SHA-256(text)[:8] seed, independently derived for each sentence/clause piece.
settings.preprocessing: Text split, eSpeak G2P, Trellis normalization/tokenization and host-side PCM transfer run on CPU.
settings.runtimeAndModelLicenses: GPL-3.0 model and GPL-3.0-or-later official browser files; acknowledgment required.
